kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أضطرم (form VIII)
# أَضْطَرِمُ (ʔaḍṭarimu) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.ri.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
# أَضْطَرِمَ (ʔaḍṭarima) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.ri.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
# أَضْطَرِمْ (ʔaḍṭarim) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.rim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
